SUPER CUBE

The Puzzle Dimension Awaits

Join Kaito and his friends as they navigate a world of shifting cubes, solving mind-bending puzzles to save their dimension from the encroaching Null Void. The ultimate anime adventure begins now!

Main Characters

Kaito

The Cube Master with the ability to manipulate spatial dimensions.

Luna

The strategist who can predict cube permutations before they happen.

Rex

The brute force solver who smashes through cube barriers.

Professor Q

The genius behind the theory of cubic dimensions.

The Story

In a world where reality is built on shifting cubic dimensions, young Kaito discovers he has the rare ability to manipulate the fundamental structure of space. When the Null Void begins consuming entire cube sectors of their world, Kaito must master his powers and assemble a team of cube solvers to restore balance to their dimension.
